He played college basketball for the [[Cal State Bakersfield Roadrunners men's basketball|Cal State Bakersfield Roadrunners]] and the [[Houston Cougars men's basketball|Houston Cougars]]. ==College career== Moore began his college career at Cal State Bakersfield. He played for the Roadrunners from 2016 to 2021, earning first-team All-[[Big West Conference]] honors as a senior. He struggled with injuries during his CSUB career, missing the entire [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] with a broken tibia and fibula in his right knee.{{cite web|first=Chris|last=Baldwin|title=The Incredible Story of Taze Moore and His Million Dollar Leg — Tragedy, Friends Lost and a Hothead Turned UH Team Player|url=https://www.papercitymag.com/culture/taze-moore-houston-leg-injury-dunks-friends-murdered-southaven/|website=PaperCityMag.com|publisher=Paper City|date=January 14, 2022|access-date=January 22, 2024}}{{cite web|first=Dwain|last=Price|title=Despite growing up seeing traumatizing things, Moore turned his life around|url=https://www.mavs.com/moorenolongerahothead/|website=Mavs.com|publisher=[[Dallas Mavericks]]|date=July 11, 2023|access-date=January 22, 2024}} Following the 2020–21 season, he entered the [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]] transfer portal.{{cite web|first=Nick|last=Ellis|title=CSUB's Taze Moore enters transfer portal|url=https://www.bakersfield.com/sports/college/csubs-taze-moore-enters-transfer-portal/article_842644b4-8d19-11eb-8cac-8bb17c29fb01.html|website=Bakersfield.com|publisher=[[The Bakersfield Californian]]|date=March 24, 2021|access-date=January 22, 2024}} Moore ultimately chose the University of Houston and coach [[Kelvin Sampson]] for his final year of eligibility. He was a starter for a Cougars team that went 32–6, averaging 10.4 points and 4.9 rebounds in his sole season with the team. ==Professional career== ===BG Göttingen (2022)=== After going undrafted in the [[2022 NBA draft]], Moore joined the [[Brooklyn Nets]] for the [[2022 NBA Summer League]]{{cite web|title=2022 NBA2K23 Summer League Roster|url=https://www.nba.com/summer-league/2022/vegas/team/1610612751/nets|website=NBA.com|access-date=August 11, 2024}} and on August 4, 2024, he signed with [[BG Göttingen]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]],{{cite web|first=Tobias|last=Forster|title=Taze Moore komplettiert den Göttinger Kader|url=https://www.bblprofis.de/index.php/2022/08/04/taze-moore-komplettiert-den-goettinger-kader/|website=BBLProfis.de|date=August 4, 2022|access-date=August 11, 2024|language=German}} where he played one game before leaving the team on October 6.{{cite web|first=Jan-Christopher|last=Dinsel|title=Tazé Moore verlässt die BG Göttingen|url=https://www.bblprofis.de/index.php/2022/10/06/taze-moore-verlaesst-die-bg-goettingen/|website=BBLProfis.de|date=October 6, 2022|access-date=August 11, 2024|language=German}} ===Texas Legends, Rip City Remix and Portland Trail Blazers (2022–2024)=== On October 22, 2022, Moore joined the [[Texas Legends]] of the [[NBA G League]] after being selected 9th overall in the 2022 NBA G League draft.{{cite web|title=Legends Draft Two, Finalize Training Camp Roster|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/legends-draft-two-finalize-training-camp-roster/n-5892719|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=October 22, 2022|access-date=August 11, 2024}} Across the 2022–23 season, he averaged 13.9 points, 3.7 assists and 6.7 rebounds per game.{{cite web|title=Taze Moore Player Profile|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Taze-Moore/Summary/106684|website=RealGM.com|date=January 11, 2024|access-date=January 22, 2024}} On October 16, 2023, Moore signed with the [[Dallas Mavericks]],{{cite tweet|author=Mavs PR|title=The Dallas Mavericks have signed Taze Moore.|number=1713923163342475443|user=MavsPR|date=October 16, 2023|access-date=January 23, 2024}} but was waived the next day.{{cite tweet|author=Mavs PR|title=The Dallas Mavericks have waived Taze Moore.|number=1714401434073022909|user=MavsPR|date=October 17, 2023|access-date=January 23, 2024}} Twelve days later, he rejoined the Legends{{cite web|first=Britney|last=Wynn|title=LEGENDS DRAFT FOUR, FINALIZE TRAINING CAMP ROSTER|url=https://texas.gleague.nba.com/news/legends-draft-four-finalize-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=October 29, 2023|access-date=January 23, 2024}} and on January 11, 2024, he was traded to the [[Rip City Remix]].{{cite web|first=Britney|last=Wynn|title=Legends acquire draft picks in trade with Rip City|url=https://texas.gleague.nba.com/news/legends-acquire-draft-picks-in-trade-with-rip-city|website=NBA.com|date=January 11, 2024|access-date=January 22, 2024}} On January 20, 2024, Moore signed a 10-day contract with the [[Portland Trail Blazers]],{{cite web|title=Trail Blazers Sign Taze Moore To 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/trail-blazers-sign-taze-moore-to-10-day-contract|website=NBA.com|date=January 20, 2024|access-date=January 23, 2024}}{{cite web|first=Aaron|last=Fentress|title=Portland Trail Blazers sign guard Taze Moore from Rip City Remix to 10-day contract|url=https://www.oregonlive.com/blazers/2024/01/portland-trail-blazers-sign-guard-taze-moore-from-rip-city-remix-to-10-day-contract.html|website=Oregonlive.com|publisher=[[The Oregonian]]|date=January 20, 2024|access-date=January 22, 2024}} making his NBA debut the next day. He scored two points and recorded a steal in 4 minutes off the bench.{{cite web|title=Taze Moore Makes NBA Debut with Portland Trail Blazers|url=https://gorunners.com/news/2024/1/22/mens-basketball-taze-moore-makes-nba-debut-with-portland-trail-blazers.aspx|website=GoRunners.com|publisher=[[Cal State Bakersfield Roadrunners]]|date=January 22, 2024|access-date=January 23, 2024}} The move made Moore the first player in Remix franchise history to earn an NBA call-up.{{cite web|first=Andrew|last=Hanlon|title=Blazers news: New lineup sticking, new guard debuts, Brogdon trade value rising|url=https://ripcityproject.com/posts/portland-trail-blazers-news-new-lineup-sticking-new-guard-debuts-brogdon-trade-value-rising|website=RipCityProject.com|publisher=[[FanSided]]|date=January 22, 2024|access-date=January 22, 2024|quote=The Blazers organization acquired Moore from the Texas Legends last week, the Dallas Mavericks' G League affiliate, so he officially became the first member of the Rip City Remix to make the jump to the big leagues.}} On January 30, he returned to the Remix.{{cite web|title=2023-2024 Rip City Remix Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/dleague/teams/Rip-City-Remix/67/Transaction_History/2024|website=RealGM.com|access-date=January 31, 2024}} On April 14, he signed with the Trail Blazers for the rest of the season.{{cite tweet|author=Portland Trail Blazers|title=OFFICIAL: Trail Blazers have signed guard Taze Moore for the remainder of the season.|number=1779573367269687694|user=trailblazers|date=April 14, 2024|access-date=April 14, 2024}} ===Vancouver Bandits (2024)=== On April 18, 2024, Moore signed with the [[Vancouver Bandits]] of the [[Canadian Elite Basketball League]].{{cite web|title=Vancouver Bandits Sign Portland Trail Blazers Guard Taze Moore|url=https://www.cebl.ca/vancouver-bandits-sign-portland-trail-blazers-guard-taze-moore|website=CEBL.ca|date=April 18, 2024|access-date=April 19, 2024}} ===Return to Portland / Rip City (2024–2025)=== On September 13, 2024, Moore signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Portland Trail Blazers]].{{cite web|title=Trail Blazers Sign Taze Moore To Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/trail-blazers-sign-taze-moore-to-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=September 13, 2024|access-date=September 13, 2024}} ===Pallacanestro Varese (2025–2026)=== On July 24, 2025, he signed with [[Pallacanestro Varese]] of the [[Lega Basket Serie A]] (LBA).{{Cite web|url=https://www.pallacanestrovarese.it/news/taze-moore-e-un-nuovo-giocatore-della-pallacanestro-varese|title=Tazé Moore È Un Nuovo Giocatore Della Pallacanestro Varese|last=|first=|date=July 24, 2025|website=pallacanestrovarese.it|publisher=|language=it|access-date=September 5, 2025}} ==National team career== Moore represented the US in [[3x3 basketball]], playing for Team Washington DC in the 2023 [[FIBA 3x3 World Tour]].{{cite web|title=Taze Moore USA Basketball profile|url=https://www.usab.com/players/taze-moore|website=USAB.com|publisher=[[USA Basketball]]|access-date=January 22,
